name: Order line-type FIXED AMOUNT vs BILLING ONLY on splits
expected: Quantity-split parent (qty>1 -> N qty=1 lines, SAME product, Is_Subsplit_Product__c=false) stays FIXED AMOUNT (revenue recognized); only a true LIC/MAINT subsplit line (different product, Is_Subsplit_Product__c=true / RC_41202) -> FIXED AMOUNT BILLING ONLY.
actual: Live flow Fortra_OrderItem_Set_Workday_Contract_Line_Type is now V11 (Active 2026-06-10 15:15) and the mechanism CHANGED from the scenario's V8 Original_Order_Item__c reverse-lookup: Decision_Is_Subsplit now gates purely on $Record.Product2.Is_Subsplit_Product__c. Re-firing V11 (savepoint+rollback) on the SC-3210 repro 00095351 quantity-split parent 802WC00000OQLFwYAP (DM-WCU-NRPS-5250PE, $3675, Is_Subsplit_Product__c=false): BEFORE (stale V10-era stamp)=FIXED AMOUNT BILLING ONLY -> AFTER V11 re-stamp=FIXED AMOUNT; both same-product children stay FIXED AMOUNT. Fresh post-V11 quantity-split orders confirm it natively: 00095628 parent 802WC00000PS90eYAD=FIXED AMOUNT, 00095559 (2 parents)=FIXED AMOUNT, 00095498 parent 802WC00000Onq1FYAR=FIXED AMOUNT. Subsplit positive control (Is_Subsplit_Product__c=true, RC_41202): 00095631/00095634/00095639/00095642/00095648/00095649/00095653/00095654 all = FIXED AMOUNT BILLING ONLY (incl. parents with Is_Split_Line__c=false, Original_Order_Item__c=null). Discriminator holds both ways.
evidence: Live flow retrieve Data/sc3473/e07_validation/unpackaged/flows/Fortra_OrderItem_Set_Workday_Contract_Line_Type.flow (V11, Decision_Is_Subsplit -> $Record.Product2.Is_Subsplit_Product__c). Probe log markers: E07-BEFORE parent type=FIXED AMOUNT BILLING ONLY isSubsplitProduct=false ; E07-AFTER-RESTAMP parent type=FIXED AMOUNT ; children FIXED AMOUNT. Quantity-split repro: https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Order/801WC00000kEEdKYAW/view (00095351). Fresh control https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Order/801WC00000lo7MpYAI/view (00095628). Subsplit control = orders 00095631-00095654.
notes: Scenario validates a FLOW (Fortra_OrderItem_Set_Workday_Contract_Line_Type), NOT a V21 pricing-procedure step - no V21 step is responsible for Workday line-type stamping; gating fields (ItemPricingSource/SellingModelType etc.) do not drive it. The scenario's proc_mechanism (V8 reverse-lookup compares child vs parent Product2; V9/V10 broke it) is SUPERSEDED: live active version is V11 (not V8/V9/V10), which abandons the Original_Order_Item__c reverse-lookup entirely and gates on the product-level boolean Product2.Is_Subsplit_Product__c (true => RC_41202 subsplit => BILLING ONLY; false => FIXED AMOUNT). This structurally eliminates the quantity-split-vs-subsplit conflation that SC-3210/SC-3368/SC-3347 chased: a quantity-split parent is the SAME non-subsplit product as its children, so it can never be flagged subsplit. Stale stamps on pre-V11 orders (00095351 parent, 00095362 parent: both Is_Subsplit_Product__c=false yet still BILLING ONLY) are frozen V10-era values - the flow only re-stamps on OrderItem save - NOT live defects; a save (or reprice/status cycle) corrects them, confirmed by the V11 re-fire flipping 00095351 to FIXED AMOUNT. No DML persisted (savepoint+rollback). Preflight: real UI-priced perpetual order, list $3675 non-zero, Fortra non-services RC_41000, Is_Subsplit_Product__c=false; subsplit control products real RC_41202.
verdict_reason: Live V11 stamps quantity-split parents (same product, Is_Subsplit_Product__c=false) FIXED AMOUNT and true subsplit lines (RC_41202, Is_Subsplit_Product__c=true) BILLING ONLY, matching expected behavior on real data both ways; the SC-3210/3368 conflation is structurally fixed by V11's product-flag gate.
